claim_boundary: Observed receiver-CFO slopes; uncalibrated oscillator drift is not separated from spacecraft Doppler.

method.pss_epoch_acceptance: circular distance to nearest GLRT frame epoch <= 4 samples
method.rate_fit: OLS over at least four independently aligned one-second blocks spanning at least 3 seconds
method.independent_sss: SSS supplies its own one-second epoch; PSS-timed SSS is reported separately and is not SSS-only acquisition.

recent_selection_policy: Latest ten additional completed 2026-08-25 capture-lane dwells, excluding the previously reported 150802 reference dwell, whose best receiver path has all 240 GLRT64 rank-0 probes positive in one whole-second-aligned six-second interval; path ranked by six-second positive count then full-dwell positive count.
historical_selection_policy: The pre-existing sealed ten-dwell 2026-08-21 raw-Doppler validation cohort; kept separate because its selection and manifest generation differ from the recent cohort.

pss_timed_sss_fit.timing_source: independent one-second exact-PSS epoch fit plus one 11-sample symbol

independent_sss_fit.rejection_reason: independent SSS maxima do not recover the PSS/GLRT frame epoch
